focus: Crosswalk field-by-field and file-by-file between spec-kit and OKF

findings.claim: Field crosswalk: title/description match; type/resource/tags/sources/verified/stale_after are gaps; generated/status partial
File crosswalk: concept doc analogous; index.md has no analogue (closest Phase Documentation Map); log.md partial (packet changelogs); bundle root = packet but never exported
Spec-kit ahead on levels, 40-rule validation, anchors, phase system, fingerprint sidecars, global trigger index, two completion gates
Five structural conflicts: OKF conformance universality vs specs corpus; reserved filenames; one-file-per-concept vs split surfaces; permissive vs prescriptive validation; link base

openQuestions: type field vs frontmatter allowlist and trigger-index generator
nextFocus: Candidate ideas and feasibility: typed concepts, per-folder index files, change log file, provenance and freshness fields, bundle export/import
